messages:
Elena (eng-arch): Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a long-lived refactor to split the request-router from the serving runtime.
Elena (eng-arch): Current problems: tight coupling, deploy blast radius when router changes, tests flakiness, and a pile of runtime feature flags.
Sam K: +1. Can you sketch the new boundary? e.g., what’s the API surface between router and runtime?
Elena (eng-arch): Idea: router handles auth, routing policy, per-tenant metadata. Runtime exposes a minimal execution surface: initModel(session), step(session, tokens), evict(session).
Elena (eng-arch): Rough interface:
```
// runtime API
create_session(modelId, config) -> sessionId
runtime_step(sessionId, inputTokens, kvHandles) -> {tokens, newKvHandles}
close_session(sessionId)
```
Mohit R: Metrics/observability question: how do we keep fine-grained latency breakdowns? router vs runtime.
Elena (eng-arch): Add hop-level tracing + shared trace-id. Router emits request-level events, runtime emits per-token/step metrics. We'll propagate trace-id via headers in internal gRPC.
Arun P: Migration plan? We have 60 services depending on router behaviours.
Elena (eng-arch): Phased rollout:
1) Adapter layer in router that can talk both old runtime and new runtime API (feature flagged)
2) Dark launch for a subset of traffic for new runtime
3) Canary with rollback on SLA regressions
4) Gradual flip and deprecate old paths
Sam K: Data migration: some requests rely on prefix caching in router. Where does cache live after split?
Elena (eng-arch): We keep prefix/KV cache in runtime to reduce hop cost. Router will keep a small cold-cache for routing hot-model metadata.
Mohit R: Need alerts for KV-miss storm when switching to runtime cache. Also baseline SLOs per model.
Elena (eng-arch): Agreed — will add regresion evals and synthetic load tests. Also add a "cache-warm" mode during rollout so router pre-populates runtime cache for a while.
Arun P: What's the estimated epic size? Owner?
Elena (eng-arch): Est ~8 sprints across 3 teams. Owner: me + runtime lead. Will pair with infra for infra changes.
infra-bot: CI pipeline created: https://ci.internal/reports/epic/2312 :pipeline: (tests pending)
Sam K: Docs needed: interface proto, runbook, migration checklist.
Elena (eng-arch): Will write an RFC doc with proto & runbook. Sharing draft this week. Thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
Arun P: Thanks — please include a simple backward-compat matrix in RFC.
Mohit R: +1 to runbook and evals. Also add a token-cost regression check.
Elena (eng-arch): Noted. I'll drop the RFC link here when ready.
